claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
The Artemis II crew returned safely.
Artemis II was a 10-day mission around the moon.
The Artemis II crew was recovered by a U.S. Navy ship.
The Artemis II recovery location is the Pacific Ocean, approximately 40-50 miles off the coast of San Diego, CA.
The Artemis II mission component is crewed lunar flyby recovery (splashdown).
Future Artemis missions, such as Artemis III, are intended to land on the lunar South Pole.
